The main takeaway from our work is that
the morphological alterations in acute renal failure are not necessarily irreversible.

the morphological lesions observed in acute renal failure induced by a choline-deficient diet are not the same in all animals, but rather represent the wide range of lesions which may be encountered in the human disease.
